outcome: ACE2 expression in fetal and placental tissues
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing medical termination of pregnancy (15-38 weeks gestation) or experiencing miscarriage or delivery (7-34 weeks gestation)
finding: ACE2 expression was found in placental tissues from 7 weeks gestation onwards, as well as in fetal kidney, rectum, and ileum samples from 15 weeks onwards, but was barely detectable or absent in fetal lung, brain, and heart tissues.
